title: Check: Reactions of Acids with Metal Oxides

questions.stem: What are the products when a metal oxide reacts with an acid?
questions.explanation: When a metal oxide reacts with an acid, the products are a salt and water. This is a neutralisation reaction because metal oxides are bases. The general equation is: Metal oxide + Acid → Salt + Water. No gas is produced.

questions.stem: What colour change is observed when black copper oxide reacts with dilute sulfuric acid?
questions.explanation: When black copper oxide dissolves in sulfuric acid, it forms copper sulfate solution, which is blue. The black solid disappears as it dissolves, and the colourless acid gradually turns blue. CuO + H₂SO₄ → CuSO₄ + H₂O.
